name: Liverpool John Moores University

programs.title: Business, Law and Social Sciences
programs.summary: The International Foundation Year in Business, Law, and Social Studies is a two-semester program that provides skills and knowledge for your degree. Complete it with the required grades, and you'll advance to the first year of your chosen business, law, or social studies degree at Liverpool John Moores University.

programs.title: Engineering, Computing and Life Sciences
programs.summary: The two-semester International Foundation Year in Engineering, Computing and Life Sciences provides essential knowledge in mechanics, mathematics, and physics. Complete it with the required grades and you will progress to the first year of your chosen degree at the University.

programs.title: Business
programs.summary: By successfully completing this pathway, you will be ready to progress to the second year of an undergraduate degree with a solid foundation in financial management, business strategy, and economic analysis.

programs.title: Engineering
programs.summary: By successfully completing this pathway, you will be ready to progress to the second year of an undergraduate degree with a solid foundation in key engineering principles, including circuit analysis, thermodynamics, and mechanical design, along with enhanced English language skills.

programs.title: Business, Management & Law
programs.summary: The Pre-Masters Programme in Business, Management, and Law is a one-semester course preparing you for postgraduate studies at Liverpool John Moores University. It offers academic concepts, study skills, and English training, with small class sizes and personalized attention to ensure your success.

programs.title: Engineering and Computing
programs.summary: The Pre-Masters Programme in Engineering and Computing is a one-semester course preparing you for postgraduate study at Liverpool John Moores University. It offers focused academic modules, study skills, and English training, providing knowledge in mathematics and computing with small classes and personalized support.

description: As a student at LJMU you will benefit from expert teaching in top teaching and learning facilities. You will also enjoy an active and varied student life, where you can join many clubs, societies and sports teams.
